title: onosmodium molle subsp. hispidissimum
intro: Onosmodium molle subsp. hispidissimum, commonly known as hispid-leaved Onosmodium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hispid-leaved Onosmodium include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
